integrity: The proof is exact and nonnumerical. The lower bound is a half-perimeter boundary-chain diameter argument, the upper bound is an explicit disk construction checked vertex-by-vertex, and uniqueness follows from the strict equality condition and forced diameter-pair midpoints.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to regular even polygons in the continuous convex-polygon two-center problem. It does not treat regular odd polygons, arbitrary centrally symmetric polygons, unequal disk radii, or more than two covering disks.
title: Exact two-disk covering radius of every regular even polygon
